info.description:
Steel (https://steel.dev) is an open-source browser API purpose-built for AI agents.
        
It offers endpoints for various browser actions and session management, enabling agents to navigate the web for information over long running browser sessions.
    
**Key Capabilities:**
- Control fleets of browser sessions in the cloud via API or Python/Node SDKs
- Easily extract page data as cleaned HTML, markdown, PDFs, or screenshots
- Access data behind logins with persistent cookies and automatic sign-in
- Render complex client-side content with JavaScript execution
- Bypass anti-bot measures with rotating proxies, stealth configs, and CAPTCHA solving
- Reduce token usage and costs by up to 80% with optimized page formats
- Reuse session and cookie data across multiple runs
- Debug with ease using live session viewers, replays, and embeddings

**Target Audience:**
- AI engineers and developers working with online LLMs
- Users with their own infrastructure looking to offload browser hosting operations
- Users who need to scrape the web for information
- QA teams who need to test web applications

**Get Started:**
- Open-source: Available as a Docker container for easy integration and scaling
- Cloud API: Fully hosted and managed, no setup required. Get an API key at https://steel.dev
- SDK: Available in Python, JavaScript, and more

**Documentation:**
- Check out the full documentation at https://docs.steel.dev
- Explore the SDK documentation to get started with your project
- Join our community on Discord for support and discussions

post.description: Create a project-scoped API key using a global (organization-scoped) API key. Supply projectId for an active project in the authenticated organization; scopeType must be project or omitted. Project-scoped API keys cannot create keys, and global keys cannot create other global keys. Dashboard users may also create project keys, or global keys with organization admin access. Returns the full secret once with Cache-Control: no-store; save it securely. The new key is independent: revoking the creating global key does not revoke keys it created. Missing projectId returns 400; insufficient scope returns 403; an unavailable or foreign project returns 404.

parameters.description: Filter released sessions by why they ended. Live sessions have no release reason and are excluded whenever this is set. Without an explicit status, matching failed sessions are included.

parameters.description: Only sessions created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

parameters.description: Only sessions created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.description: Signals the session must carry; repeat the parameter to require several. All must match. Derived signals are finalized at release.
parameters.name: signal

parameters.description: Exact-match metadata filters, e.g. metadata[environment]=production. All entries must match. Values match the stored string exactly; numbers and booleans are stored as strings, so metadata[attempt]=3 matches attempt sent as 3 or "3".
parameters.name: metadata
